test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive voice of the given sentence.**

A good conclusion summarises the highlights of a speech.

options.text: A good conclusion of a speech is summarised by the highlights.
A speech highlight is summarised by a good conclusion.
The good conclusion is summarised by the highlights of the speech.
The highlights of a speech are summarised in a good conclusion.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The highlights of a speech are summarised in a good conclusion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active form and in the Present Simple tense and we need to change it into the passive form.
 
• The Present Simple in the active voice has the following form: **Subject + infinitive + object**__
 
• The Present Simple in the passive voice has the following form: __**Subject + be verb (am, is, are) + past participle + by object**__
 __
 
• Active: *The grocer sells fresh vegetables.*
 
• Passive: *Fresh vegetables are sold by the grocer.*
 
 
 
• In the passive voice of the Present Simple, we have to change the structure, so the subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct Active Voice:__ *The highlights of a speech are summarised in a good conclusion.*
